text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I sent Dana the list in your DM. Moss's notes have two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct. One follow-up is still listed: archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I read all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. Two other North notes mention QFL but have no ticket numbers. The tickets in Moss's Central notes (#4409, #4412 and FR-882) belong to other accounts. I also left out Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways," which is a different company and not a customer.

The knowledge brain refused the search, so I didn't use it, and the list only covers the shared files. The brain's connection isn't tied to any one member. The person who runs the brain's server needs to set that up before it can be used here.
